title: Spicy Jjigae Stew
description: A hearty and spicy Korean-inspired stew made with nurturing ingredients and pomegranate. This gluten-free recipe is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pomegranate molasses, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Add the nurturing chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the zucchini and bell peppers to the pot and simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
